description:
S06 E04 — Daniel Roseberry
Designer Daniel Roseberry spends the day with Ina Garten, sharing fashion secrets and flower arrangements, after Ina bakes a Tri-Berry Ricotta Cake for breakfast; then, Ina teaches Daniel how to make smashed burgers with caramelized onions.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E02 — Jeffrey Garten
Jeffrey Garten joins Ina Garten to share highlights from their 60 years together, from love-at-first-sight encounters to their long-distance challenges; Ina makes easy butternut squash and apple soup; Jeffrey learns to make challah French toast.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E01 — Christina Tosi
Pastry chef and Milk Bar founder Christina Tosi joins Ina Garten to share stories about life-changing career decisions and dessert revelations; Ina makes Smoked Salmon Tartines, and Christina shares the secrets to Milk Bar's legendary Birthday Cake.

title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten
description:
S08 E04 — Yotam Ottolenghi
Garten welcomes award-winning chef Dan Barber for lively conversation about catering coincidences, high-pressure hospitality, and redefining restaurant reviews. Plus, Ina makes Cornmeal Pound Cake, and Dan shares his recipe for Miso Crusted Squash.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S14 E15 — Never Enough Puff
Ree Drummond shares her top five favorite puff pastry recipes; cheese straws and sausage Parmesan palmiers; individual beef pot pies; puff pastry pizzas; Ree's marvelous Mille Feuille.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S18 E13 — Boarding House Bites
Ree Drummond road-tests minibar snacks for her boarding house, including hometown toffee, chocolatey apricots, sprinkle cookies, Drummond Ranch potato chips, and savory, spicy cowboy cheese bites.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S30 E04 — Super Easy Italian
Ree is in her kitchen serving up simple dishes with an Italian spin; first up are Italian beef sandwiches followed by a make-ahead spaghetti pizza pie and garlic and herb mozzarella sticks; for dessert, she makes no churn spumoni.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S33 E09 — Fun Family Food
Ree Drummond makes family-friendly food with a fun spin, starting with an over-the-top bacon cheeseburger salad and colorful rainbow pizza; she mashes up potato nachos and uses store-bought shortcuts for her no-cook cookie-dough bars.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S35 E06 — Ranching & Ready to Go
While Ladd and Alex work cattle in Kansas, Ree Drummond fills the freezer with layered chicken spinach artichoke lasagnas and copycat convenience store burritos; she gets ahead with a skirt steak dinner kit for when her cowboy and cowgirl get home.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S38 E13 — Portable Dinner Party
Ree cooks for a dinner party at her best friend's house, starting with Roasted Jalapeño Pimento Cheese; the main course is Baked Sausage and Peppers Bucatini, plus Hearty Citrus Salad; for dessert, Ree whips up decadent Espresso Cream Poke Cake.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S19 E01 — Harvest of Horrors
Tasty tricks and sweet treats for Halloween; Katie Lee's green chicken chili; Jeff Mauro's Mac-O'-Lantern -- pumpkin-shaped mac and cheese; pastry chef Zac Young's Pizza Roll Intestines; playing Pass the Giant Eyeball Cake; jack-o'-lanterns.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S29 E07 — Halloween How-to Headquarters
The hosts have creepy Halloween creations and recipes for kids of all ages, including graveyard chicken enchiladas and roasted pumpkin pasta; the hosts share a dead velvet cake, leftover candy treats and unforgettable scares.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E01 — Back from the Dead: Halloween All Stars
Eight all-star teams return to battle in head-to-head challenges.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E02 — Back from the Dead: Things That Go Buzz in the Night
Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create terrifying insect-infested showpieces and daring buzz-worthy desserts inspired by coffee, tea and spirits; after an unexpected twist, judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller execute an elimination.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E03 — Back from the Dead: Misfit Monsters
Bennett asks the teams to go head-to-head with terrifying trolls, demons and ghouls. But as rivalries heat up and tensions rise, one team faces an emotional fight to impress judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller enough to stay in the competition.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E04 — Back from the Dead: Storybook Nightmares
Twisted bedtime stories come to life as Jonathan Bennett asks the five remaining teams to create terrifying moving showpieces inspired by classic tales; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which team's story has come to an end.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E05 — Back from the Dead: Nightmare Pet Shop
Monstrous pets take over as Jonathan Bennett challenges the teams to create haunted pet shop showpieces and pumpkin-infused desserts; a surprise carving battle puts the teams to the test before judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller make their decision.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E06 — Back from the Dead: Final Four
As the race to the finale heats up, Jonathan Bennett challenges the final four teams to create terrifying toys and elevated treats inspired by childhood favorites; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide which teams earn a pass to the finale.

title: Halloween Wars
description:
S16 E07 — Back from the Dead: The Final Fright
Jonathan Bennett challenges the final teams to create killer carnival showpieces, interactive games and elevated carnival treats; judges Shinmin Li and Andrew Fuller decide who will be crowned Halloween Wars champion and take home $30,000.
